ocl:
context Patient
inv: self.isInsured implies self.insurance <> null

context Hospital
inv: (self.departments->any(x | x.name <> '') <> null) and (self.departments->size() = 3)

context Hospital
inv: self.wards->any(x | x.floor > 2) <> null

context Doctor
inv: self.appointments->size() >= 1 and self.appointments->size() <= 2

context InsurancePolicy
inv: (self.patient.isInsured) and (self.provider.size() >= 5 implies self.provider.substring(1, 5) = 'AB')

context Department
inv: (self.nurses->any(x | x.nurseId <> '') <> null) and (self.nurses->exists(x | x.shift <> ''))

context MedicalRecord
inv: ((self.createdAt <> '') and (self.procedures->forAll(v | v.performedAt <> ''))) and (self.procedures->exists(v | not(v.performedAt <> '')))

context Hospital
inv: (self.wards->collect(x | x.floor)->notEmpty()) and (not(self.wards->collect(x | x.floor)->notEmpty()))

context Admission
inv: (self.discharge <> null) and (not(self.discharge <> null))

context Invoice
inv: (self.totalAmount >= 4 and self.totalAmount <= 6) and (self.totalAmount < 4)

context LabTest
inv: (self.result <> null) and (not(self.result <> null))

context Invoice
inv: (self.totalAmount >= 6 and self.totalAmount <= 65) and (self.totalAmount < 6)

context Ward
inv: ((self.floor.abs() <= 4) and (self.floor.abs() <= 3)) and (not((self.floor.abs() <= 4) and (self.floor.abs() <= 3)))

context Room
inv: (self.beds->exists(x | x.isOccupied <> true)) and (not(self.beds->exists(x | x.isOccupied <> true)))

context Ward
inv: ((self.floor > 0) and (self.rooms->forAll(v | v.roomNo <> ''))) and (self.floor < -5)

context Ward
inv: ((self.floor < 50) and (self.rooms->forAll(v | v.roomNo <> ''))) and (self.floor > 55)

context Doctor
inv: ((self.specialty <> '') and (self.appointments->forAll(v | v.appointmentId <> ''))) and (self.appointments->exists(v | not(v.appointmentId <> '')))

context Department
inv: ((self.doctors->size() > 0) and (self.name <> null)) and (self.doctors->size() < -5)
